description: Read-only: fetch recent incidents from a public Atlassian Statuspage-hosted status page (e.g. https://www.githubstatus.com) via its free, unauthenticated JSON API at <base>/api/v2/incidents.json. Returns each incident's name, status, impact, created_at, resolved_at and shortlink. No login or API key.

page_url.description: Base URL of a Statuspage-hosted status page, e.g. https://www.githubstatus.com (must be https)

name: get_statuspage_incidents
